glyph.isekai_mahou.crystal_lotus.desc: A crystal flower blooms on the target (or where you look) and spins for 5.5s, firing shards in a spiral (3 damage each; Crystal builds Petrification). At the end it bursts into a crown of shards. Split = +1 spiral arm (max 5).
glyph.isekai_mahou.prism_cannon.desc: A white beam passes through a crystal prism in front of you and splits into a fan of 7 beams for 1.4s, one per element: Fire, Sun, Lightning, Nature (poison), Ice, Abyss (soaks) and Crystal (Exposed). Reactions between them really happen! Expand = wider, longer fan.
glyph.isekai_mahou.black_hole.desc: Opens a black hole above the target for 6.5s: pulls enemies, items, XP and projectiles within 12 blocks and grinds whoever reaches the core. With destruction on, it DEVOURS the terrain: a growing erased sphere and blocks torn from the ground spiraling into it. At the end it collapses in an explosion.
glyph.isekai_mahou.starfall.desc: Marks the ground and drops 9 stars (+3 per Split) over a radius-7 area in 2.5s, enemies first: 5 area damage, knockback, Exposed and small craters.
glyph.isekai_mahou.black_flame_pillar.de: The ground cracks in a red circle and, 0.8s later, a 16-block column of black fire erupts for 3s: launches upward, burns nonstop (stacking Burning) and scorches the ground. Split = extra pillars on other enemies.
glyph.isekai_mahou.soul_burn.desc: Deals 3 and lights the SOUL flame for 6s: every second, 1.5 + 4% of the target's max health (bosses 1.2%); on players it consumes mana and turns it into damage. Water does not put it out. Whoever dies burning spreads the flame to 2 nearby enemies.
glyph.isekai_mahou.kraken_grasp.desc: Four giant tentacles (+1 per Split) burst from the ground around the target for 7s. Far enemy: the tentacle rears up and SLAMS down along a marked line (8 damage, cracks the ground). Close: grabs, lifts, squeezes and hurls it into the ground. Abyss: leaves Wet.
glyph.isekai_mahou.abyssal_maw.desc: A colossal mouth bursts from the ground under the target, sucks in whoever is near and shuts: the swallowed vanish inside it, get chewed for 2s (damage and Corrupted) and are spat far away. Bosses don't fit and take a heavy bite.
glyph.isekai_mahou.planet_crush.desc: A gravity core rises from the ground, tears up the terrain around it and pulls enemies within 10 blocks. The torn blocks form a SPHERE OF ROCK around them that spins, crushes and caves in with a final stunning blow. The debris falls and crumbles away.
glyph.isekai_mahou.gravity_well.desc: Field of multiplied gravity (radius 6, 6s): the ground sinks, crushed, and everyone inside is pinned to it (slowed, no jumping; flyers plummet; enemy projectiles drop). Damages every second, double to anyone airborne.
glyph.isekai_mahou.dimension_slash.desc: A streak of light cuts space in a straight line (22 blocks) and opens into a rift to the void: 14 damage that IGNORES armor and passes through walls, Bleeding 3, and truly cuts the terrain. Split = extra cuts in a fan.
glyph.isekai_mahou.void_rift.desc: Opens a rift on the target and another high in the sky. The lower one sucks in enemies and items for 4.5s; whoever falls in is spat out of the upper one (5 damage, Exposed) and plummets. Bosses can't pass: they take damage and become Exposed.
glyph.isekai_mahou.ragnarok.desc: Three waves of telegraphed pillars strike the area (radius 10): a ring of LIGHT (vitrifies the ground, Exposed), a ring of SHADOW (digs holes, Corrupted) and a pillar on every enemy; finally the twin central pillar blasts a crater. Light followed by shadow causes Rupture.
glyph.isekai_mahou.yin_yang.desc: A yin-yang orb spins for 9s (on Self, it floats above you). Every second it heals allies and removes one bad condition from them, and damages enemies alternating Light and Shadow (Rupture).
legend.isekai_mahou.planetary_devastatio: A fast projectile carries an empowered gravity core: it tears up the terrain in a huge radius, traps enemies in a spinning, crushing moon of rock and then makes it cave in.
legend.isekai_mahou.event_horizon.desc: A slow orb that, on touching anything, collapses into a colossal, long-lasting black hole: it pulls everything in and devours the terrain until it explodes.
legend.isekai_mahou.twilight_of_the_gods: Ragnarok at full scale: waves of light and shadow pillars rain down on a vast area, ending with the twin pillar that blasts open a crater.
effect.isekai_mahou.fd_soul_burn.descrip: The soul is burning: loses health (and mana) every second. Water does not put it out.
death.attack.isekai_mahou.fd_dimension_s: %1$s was split in half by space itself
%1$s was split in half by %2$s's Dimension Slash
